title: Shadowmeld
smart_description: Double your [gold]Block[/gold] gain this turn [blue]X[/blue] times (where X is the stack count).
notes: Block gain is multiplied by 2^(stack count). Each additional stack doubles the effect: 1 stack = 2× block, 2 stacks = 4× block, 3 stacks = 8× block, etc. Removes itself at the end of the turn.
